title: Concept
description: A labeled value from an optionally specified concept scheme

anyOf.title: Concept
anyOf.description: The value of the concept, expressed as a string. This is only used when the concept is not further described by the properties of the Concept object and is not linked to a concept scheme.

altLabelMap.description: Language map for alternate label. E.g. {'es': 'spanish words', 'fr': 'french words'}

definition.title: definition
definition.description: Definition of the controlled vocabulary term

definitionMap.description: Language map for definition. E.g. {'es': 'spanish words', 'fr': 'french words'}

notation.title: notation
notation.description: List of abbreviations or codes from code lists for an organization

prefLabelMap.description: Language map for preferred label. E.g. {'es': 'spanish words', 'fr': 'french words'}
